notes: Bench machine profile. The pipeline measures the STL it produced and refuses the job unless the part fits inside the build volume above, turned whichever way it needs to be. It does not check which plastic you use against the list in this profile — that choice is yours. What it does take from your material is the density you typed: that number, not the material name, is what the mass check is computed from, so a wrong density buys you a mass check that agrees with itself and proves nothing. What comes off this machine is shop and bench work only — jigs, fixtures, form blocks, soft jaws and prototypes. Do not put any of it in something that flies, carries a person, or holds a load.
